partition.numbering_basis: Ascending physical x; column is physical rank for a linear array, not connector signal.
partition.role_overlap_basis: No imaging role; only selected physical ranks transmit.

operating_envelope.basis: Nominal burst envelope; not voltage high-state time, acoustic energy, temperature or cure.
operating_envelope.element_load_basis: Nominal per-element burst envelope; aggregate is element-us, not acoustic or electrical energy.
operating_envelope.local_duty_basis: Maximum of configured burst/PRI and burst/shortest compiled same-role start interval lower bound, plus each physical element previous-burst/next-start ratio across both roles, including configured TX.Delay. With fewer than two starts, only configured ratios are available. Scheduled nominal estimates, not measured output.

timing.description: Scheduled lower bound, not an exact hardware period. Within-group TTNA includes acquisition time; only group-final explicit noops are added, with no pending TTNA at group boundaries. Final-acquisition execution, DMA, processing, command overhead and profile transitions may add time. Completion noops add the full effective duration after the acquisition event. All settle, recovery and recharge values are assumed; 5000 us cannot guarantee profile completion (D00163 Rev. K/L section 12.1 reports up to 6-8 ms).
timing.duty_cycle_basis: Per-supercycle nominal pulse time divided by the scheduled cycle lower bound; an upper estimate for that nominal timing model, not measured acoustic exposure, successful curing, or a clinical safety conclusion.

limitations: Exposure settings and charge/profile waits are assumed, not calibrated curing parameters.
Original probe dimensions and 35 V software cap are not manufacturer burst/thermal ratings.
No Receive object or acquisition does not mean physical receiver isolation.
No imaging recovery wait is emitted because no imaging follows; recharge waits remain.
Profile 5 availability and probe thermal monitoring remain unknown.
Finite stop freezes the sequence; unfreeze can repeat it, without cross-run cumulative protection.
VSX loading, waveform quantization, acoustic output and actual curing are not validated.
